newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sign gem deal with De Beers by June 4.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sign gem deal with De Beers by June 4.

text.p: Russia will sign a long-delayed gem trade deal with South African diamond giant De Beers by June 4 at the latest, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Wednesday.
"We will put the final touches to this document (with De Beers) no later than June 3-4," Chubais told reporters in the autonomous diamond-producing region of Yakutia.
"The government has reached an agreement on all the principal points, and it only remains to complete the legal drafting (of the document)," he said.

Chubais said that a document outlining gem export quotas for the whole of 1997 would be signed by the end of May. The government has already signed a decree on diamond export quotas covering the period until the end of May.
"Today it is advantageous to work with De Beers, and we will work with them...but if we are ready to work on our own, we will do so," he said. "The important thing is not to hurry and not to delay."
De Beers sharply curtailed its purchases of Russian diamonds at the end of last year when Moscow failed to communicate its position on a draft agreement submitted to the cabinet in October 1996.
